question.description: The question to present to a human for a decision, e.g. 'Proceed with deployment?'.

options.description: 2-4 short option labels the human can pick from, e.g. ['yes', 'no'].

allow_free_text.description: Whether the human may also (or instead) supply free-text input alongside/instead of picking an option. Defaults to true.

api_key.description: EpicStaff API key used to authenticate the decision open/poll/cancel calls (sent as the X-Api-Key header). Set this in the tool configuration, not by the agent.

api_base_url.description: Base URL of the EpicStaff Django REST API, e.g. http://djangoapp:8000/api. Optional -- if unset, falls back to the DJANGO_API_URL environment variable, then to http://djangoapp:8000/api.

poll_timeout_s.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a human decision before giving up and resuming the flow with a timeout error. Optional, default 900 (15 minutes). Keep this well under the session's time_to_live so the session doesn't expire while still 'waiting'.
